atAGlance: Bánh tráng trộn is tossed rice paper salad, usually with shredded rice paper, green mango, herbs, quail egg, dried beef or shrimp, and chili.
whatItIs: Bánh tráng trộn is mixed rice-paper salad tossed with green mango, herbs, chili, quail egg, dried beef or shrimp, peanuts, and tangy seasoning.
howToEnjoy: Eat it soon after mixing, while the rice paper is chewy rather than soggy. Ask for less chili or no peanuts before the vendor tosses the bag or bowl.
howLocalsOrder: Order bánh tráng trộn as a made-to-order snack. Ask for less spice, no peanuts, or no dried shrimp before everything is mixed.
worthKnowing: The fun is texture: chewy rice paper, sour mango, chili heat, herbs, and crunchy toppings all changing as it sits.
goodToKnow: This snack often includes dried shrimp, quail egg, peanuts, chili, and tart tamarind dressing; ask no chili early if heat matters.
